name: Lake Catani

facts.claim: Reservoir of about 15 hectares formed by a 1910 arch dam across Eurobin Creek, built for the Mount Buffalo Chalet's water supply
Lies in Mount Buffalo National Park in the Victorian Alps
Parks Victoria describes it as an alpine spot good for a swim, with a campground on its shore and wombats around

name: Mount Buffalo Chalet

facts.claim: Built in 1910 by the Public Works Department as the first ski resort in the Victorian Alps
The largest timber building in Australia
Heritage-listed; the exterior with interpretive signage and the terraced European gardens can be visited free
Its cafe has reopened to the public on weekends and Victorian public holidays

name: Bogong High Plains

facts.claim: Plateau in Alpine National Park south of Mount Bogong, one of the largest snow-covered areas in Australia in winter
Reached from Falls Creek and Hotham resorts
Used for bushwalking and mountain biking in summer and cross-country skiing in winter; the Australian Alps Walking Track crosses it

name: Mount Bogong

facts.claim: Highest mountain in Victoria at 1,986 metres
Lies in Alpine National Park, about 30 km by road and track from Mount Beauty
Summit ridgeline is exposed with sudden weather changes; emergency shelters at Bivouac Hut on Staircase Spur, Cleve Cole and Michell's Hut

name: Mount Hotham

Resort runs a tracks and trails network and guided walks in summer
